thirty_reflections: The new wait rule is strongest when it becomes an auditable overlay rather than a vague intention.
Skill design should remain draft-only until exact skill paths are authorized for live mutation.
Enabled and Disabled labels are useful as planning controls, but unsafe as broad live edits.
A 15-minute x1 window can produce source breadth, draft skills, and build-ready eureka tasks without polling siblings.
A 15-minute x2 wait window should lead directly into a 30-minute build/use block, not another planning loop.
OpenAI Codex safety material reinforces boundary-aware sandbox, approval, and telemetry thinking.
Windows sandbox issue research should guide diagnostics without assuming every public issue matches this machine.
MCP authorization sources reinforce resource-bound tokens, audience checks, and no token passthrough.
MCP security best practices make connector routing a security surface, not just a convenience layer.
OWASP MCP Tool Poisoning reinforces schema validation, trusted servers, and least-privilege tool isolation.
OWASP Agent Memory Guard reinforces treating durable memory and continuity artifacts as mutable attack surfaces.
GitHub branch protection sources support exact staging and avoiding direct broad mutation.
GitHub OIDC and npm trusted publishing sources support short-lived credentials and provenance thinking.
Google Agent Sandbox sources reinforce ephemeral isolated runtimes for untrusted generated code.
Google tracing sources support watcher receipts that show timing and event flow without raw payloads.
Google agent evaluation sources support trajectory and final-response evaluation as separate concerns.
NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails sources support programmable input, retrieval, execution, and output rails.
NVIDIA NIM sources support modular inference service thinking without implying deployed NIM infrastructure.
OpenUSD digital-twin sources are useful architecture inspiration for compositional simulation ledgers.
W3C DID sources support decentralized identifiers as control and resolution structures, not mystical identity proof.
W3C VC sources support claims, issuer, holder, verifier, proof, and presentation framing for Freed ID design.
NIST SP 800-63-4 supports assurance-level language and risk management for identity systems.
Nature transparency guidance warns against multi-agent complexity without clear value, evaluation, and documentation.
Multi-agent routing research supports measuring coordination stability instead of assuming it.
Clinical multi-agent workload research supports orchestration as useful when task division is explicit and measured.
MCP threat-model research supports guardrails against prompt injection and tool poisoning in connector workflows.
The sibling wait period should produce Aletheon artifacts independently, not idle supervision.
The harvest gate protects sibling continuity by waiting long enough without repeatedly peeking.
Every blocker should get five varied safe attempts and then a clear receipt, not invisible retries.
The next x2 should build a concrete validator or watcher improvement from this ledger before phase advance.
twenty_x1_eureka_tasks_for_x2: Build a v8 x2 wait-policy guard run that verifies 30+ searches, 10+ draft skills, 30 reflections, and 15-minute cadence.
Create a skill-overlay approval candidate for any future live skill enable/disable edits.
Add a source-ledger dedupe helper that keeps source groups primary-source weighted.
Extend no-overclaim guard examples for identity, simulation, and multi-agent capability claims.
Create a connector-boundary checklist for MCP/app-server routes before any external connector use.
Create a watcher trust receipt that distinguishes background supervision from manual polling.
Create a command-risk summary for helpers that launch processes, mutate files, or touch external accounts.
Create a Freed ID assurance map tying DID, VC, NIST assurance, consent, recourse, and privacy together.
Create a THOS body-runtime map tying sandbox, TUI, app-server, CLI, watcher, and notifier surfaces together.
Create a GMUT open-gate map that labels physics, empirical, consciousness, and canon gates as open.
Prepare a v497 phase-sequence preflight so the run cannot skip v496 v8 x2.
Add a stale-flow retry receipt template with five varied safe attempts per blocker.
Create a journey-reflection index that references older records by bounded anchor only.
Create a sibling-prompt refinement that asks for build-ready output and exact blocker classes.
Create an x2 build-minimum receipt that records at least 30 minutes of build/run/test/use work.
Prepare a helper-script inventory that marks candidates for keep, improve, approval-needed, or disabled-overlay.
Prepare an app-lane completion gate that consumes status-only receipts without raw app payloads.
Prepare a CLI final-marker review checklist that separates false-positive secret wording from true blockers.
Prepare a no-broad-stage checklist for future commits in the dirty worktree.
Publish only after all five lanes are harvested or a safe explicit blocker receipt is produced.
